decision: The official Google HDR+ Burst Photography Dataset exposes one deterministically selected, independently addressable bounded RAW burst with capture sidecars and two matching result inventories. This opens only a separately preregistered one-burst acquisition and source-only capture-time RAW D0; it does not authorize that acquisition or admit candidate 3.
preformal_exclusions: A read-only object-shape diagnostic enumerated the 153 immediate prefixes and selected object metadata before the formal runner was committed. It read no object payload body and decoded no pixel.

The first development report failed only because the parser checked abbreviated payload_N.dng and lens_shading_map_N.tiff tokens while the official page spells payload_N<frame>.dng and lens_shading_map_N<frame>.tiff. The parser literal and its unit fixture were corrected before formal lock; source, selection, objects, budgets and gates did not change.
No 37 GiB curated subset or 765 GiB full release was downloaded. No selected member body was downloaded during this leaf.
claim_ceiling: Private zero-pixel official HDR+ source and object feasibility only. No object-body acquisition, HDR truth or quality, natural-image evaluation, commercial/share-alike resolution, package, schema, capability, product mapping or candidate-3 admission.
